body.x: Thirdeye unveiled smart glasses ‘X1’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

Thirdeye, AR glasses specialty company provides state-of-the-art X1 with AR-software to consumers in enterprise and education field. When wearing X1 smart glasses, main three screens show up. On the front of the screen, the user can see the front view and on the left side of the screen, the user can see live video and listen to audio of others. In addition, on the right side of the screen, the user also can see the AR data he or she wants.

The X1 smart glasses have great technologies such as 1280x720p binocular display, GPS, 3-axis gyroscope, 3-axis accelerometer, 3-axis compass, Bluetooth, and 2,400 mAh battery. Thirdeye is designed for operators to use the X1 hands-free freely, making it available to a wide range of companies, from industrial centers to universities and law enforcement agencies.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
